business.name: Harbourstone Paving & Gardens
business.tagline: Driveways, patios and gardens built to last, across the Bay of Plenty.

services.name: Driveways
services.description: Exposed aggregate, concrete pavers or cobbles, with proper base and drainage.

services.name: Patios and outdoor rooms
services.description: Stone and paver patios sized for how you actually use the backyard.

services.name: Retaining walls
services.description: Timber, block and stone walls, engineered where the council needs it.

services.name: Garden design and planting
services.description: Low-maintenance native planting plans, edging, lawn and irrigation.

highlights: We clean up every day on site

about.story: Harbourstone started with one ute and a plate compactor in 2012. Today it is a crew of four, and the owner still measures every job and signs off every finish. Most of our work comes from neighbours of people we have already worked for.
about.photoAlt: Close-up of grey granite pavers laid in a straight bond
